_source: CBP ruling N341280 (26 Jul 2024): USB-C 11-in-1 hub, PCBA made in China, assembled in Taiwan: CBP held China. N342837 (3 Oct 2024): the PCBA soldered in Taiwan: CBP held Taiwan. Both rulings are in the selection pool (not dev or held-out) and both are excluded. Plant capabilities for Taiwan are an assumption.

product.name: USB-C 11-in-1 Hub (Hub), Item No. C112H-R
product.description: The USB-C 11-in-1 Hub connects to an automatic data processing machine to attach peripherals, memory cards, and network connections. It consists of an aluminum enclosure, a plastic end cap, and a printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) with multiple ports and sockets such as USB, HDMI, SD card slots, and an RJ45 port.
